title: Wire Break Apart (Ctrl+B) into Modify menu and keyboard shortcut
description: breakApart() is fully implemented in packages/core/src/engine/shapeOps.ts but is not wired in the UI. Flash 8: Modify > Break Apart (Ctrl+B) decomposes a selected SymbolInstance into its raw shapes on the current layer. When applied to text, it first breaks text into characters, then into shapes on second press. Wire it into: (1) Shell.tsx keyboard handler for Ctrl+B, (2) MenuBar.tsx Modify menu as 'Break Apart  Ctrl+B'. Call breakApart(doc, selection) and push the result via pushDoc.
